svg.title: Claim Credential Architecture Flow
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from organizer auth through email delivery, claim page, Soroban NFT mint, and confirmation email.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the organizer auth step')
sendPrompt('What does the Express backend do in the credential flow?')
sendPrompt('How is the unique token generated and stored?')
sendPrompt('What email does the recipient receive?')
sendPrompt('What happens on the claim page?')
sendPrompt('What does the submit claim step trigger?')
sendPrompt('How does the Soroban contract mint the NFT?')
sendPrompt('What does the confirmation email contain?')
